name: Pattern 1: Process-Agent-Role
description: Shows how roles are assigned to agents participating in processes while staying aligned with BFO: bfo:Process is an Occurrent, nfdicore:Agent is an Independent Continuant that participates in the process, and bfo:Role is a Specifically Dependent Continuant borne by the agent. The object properties has_participant, realizes and bearer_of tie the three together.
competency_questions: Who took part in a given activity, and in what capacity did each of them take part?; In which activities was a given role actually carried out, rather than only held?; Which activities has a given person or organization taken part in, and which of their roles did each of those activities put to use?
competency_questions_source: derived from the pattern's own axioms during the OntoBoard review and checked against them; the upstream submission states none
